tasks.text: Add scope_tier column (TEXT DEFAULT 'feature') to agent_invocations and otel_spans in src/pathly_orchestrator/db/migrations_incremental.py additive-column list.

Universal projector: map every AGENT_DONE payload to one agent_invocations row (run_id, stage, agent_role, tokens, cost_usd, session_id, summary, scope_tier). Call from the single append point so board/single/loop are covered. Best-effort, never raises.
Executor scope_tier tagging: thread board (feature|project|global) -> scope_tier into the projector from scheduler.py / goal_run.py / board_run.py.
goal=trace, task=span: mint a trace_id per goal run (root span = goal); each task worker writes an otel_span with that trace_id and parent_span_id = goal span.
Aggregation endpoint: new db_api_rollup.py with GET /db/rollup returning project + global sums grouped by scope_tier over agent_invocations. Pure aggregation, no stored counters. Under 400 lines.
DB Explorer roll-up UI: feature->project->global view + scope_tier column on Agents/OTel tables. Renderer typecheck must stay clean.
Tests: projector writes a row for synthetic board/single/loop AGENT_DONE; aggregation feature-sums equal project total and global has no duplicate facts.
